title: Feature/get product by ID
diff_summary: Changes to products/src/main/java/com/shabushabu/javashop/products/controllers/ProductController.java: Adds a new @GetMapping('/products/{id}') endpoint that retrieves a product by ID using ProductService.getProduct(id) and throws ResponseStatusException(NOT_FOUND) if not found. The healthCheck() method was reordered to appear before the new endpoint.
